def find_beautiful_sequence(k, q):
    if len(q) < k:
        return "NO"
    
    # Check if we can have distinct first characters
    if len(set(q[:k])) != k:
        return "NO"
    
    # Create the sequence
    sequence = []
    used_chars = set()
    i = 0
    
    for _ in range(k):
        # Find the first character that hasn't been used yet
        while q[i] in used_chars:
            i += 1
        start_char = q[i]
        used_chars.add(start_char)
        
        # Find the end of the current string
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(q) and q[j] == start_char:
            j += 1
        
        # Add the current string to the sequence
        sequence.append(q[i:j])
        i = j
    
    return "YES\n" + "\n".join(sequence)

# Read input
